_comment: The DSH runtimes this plugin has actually been exercised against. The declared peer range has no upper ceiling: everything at or above 0.2.0-0 is accepted, and only a runtime below that floor is refused. A runtime newer than the newest entry here is still accepted; scripts/check-runtime-peer.mjs warns that it was not exercised. Add an entry only after a compatibility check, with the date of that check.
